title: 61 Seats: Israel Election, Netanyahu, Knesset #Shorts
description:
Israel votes for all 120 seats in the Knesset, its first election since Oct 7, 2023. Why 61 is the magic number, why neither bloc reaches it, and what happens next: the president's pick, 28 days (+14), then others try, or Israel votes again.

Poll figures are pre-election polls, not results.

Sources: Times of Israel (final polls, ~24 Oct 2026; 2026 elections explainer), Jerusalem Post (poll average, 25 Oct 2026), The New Arab (20 Oct 2026).

Footage: stock clips and Wikimedia Commons photos for illustration, not of the actual event. Hosts Arjun and Meera are AI-generated hosts.

Made by AI. Made with hope.

#Shorts #NewsExplained #WorldNews #IsraelElection #Explained
script:
FORMAT: 9:16, ~52-57s, 22 shots, cut every 2-3s. Label "AI-generated hosts" on screen. Hosts Arjun (explainer), Meera (journalist), from saved reference photos.

SCRIPT
ARJUN: "Sixty-one. That's the number Israel's next leader needs, and polls suggest nobody has it."
MEERA: "Israel votes today for all 120 seats in its parliament, the Knesset, its first election since the October 7, 2023 attacks."
ARJUN: "It's widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu. Both camps are defined as pro- or anti-Netanyahu."
MEERA: "Polls average former army chief Gadi Eisenkot's party, Yashar, narrowly ahead of Likud, by about two seats."
ARJUN: "But seats are counted in blocs. Per the Jerusalem Post average, the opposition bloc leads by about 4.5 seats, yet neither bloc reaches 61. Netanyahu's bloc polls 48 to 51."
MEERA: "The swing factor? Arab parties, polling about 14 seats, up from 10 now. Some partners in Eisenkot's bloc are wary of working with them."
ARJUN: "No party has ever won a majority alone. The president picks whoever is likeliest to form a government, not automatically the biggest party. They get 28 days, extendable by 14. If that fails, others can try. If all fail, Israel votes again."
MEERA: "Coalition or another election: which comes first?"
ARJUN: "Exit polls tonight. Final results take days. Follow for the result explained."
